report:
Reviewed the complete dependencies claim, four inventoried ordinary implementation entries (driver, metadata, compile/mod, compile/rustc), and the one ordinary real_std test. No TODO or N/A entries exist. Requirements are (1) a default fixture receives the real standard library, (2) its dependency metadata is available, and (3) V1 makes no promise of arbitrary third-party dependency configuration. CompileTest creates a normal standalone library manifest without no_std or replacement dependency configuration and opens SageHost. metadata::our_sysroot returns the build-time SAGE_SYSROOT; the captured build script obtains it from rustc --print=sysroot. driver::build_rustc_args passes that sysroot to the embedded compiler, whose normal library stub loads std and whose after_expansion callback keeps TyCtxt metadata available through the request service. The metadata loader deliberately skips Cargo dependency builds for dependency-free fixtures because std comes from the sysroot. The independent rustc::check uses the matching rustc executable and explicit same sysroot. The harness exposes no arbitrary dependency field, consistent with the V1 scope qualification; third-party support is not treated as an unimplemented obligation here.

The complete associated test real_std visibly compiles a function with a std::string::String parameter and asserts an empty diagnostic expectation. This traverses a real standard-library path and its allocation-backed String metadata rather than supplying a fake local stand-in. The captured observe helper checks function signatures, collects accumulated signature diagnostics, and validates exact marker matching, so unresolved metadata cannot silently satisfy the empty expectation. CompileTest::run compares the actual prepared diagnostics; prepare additionally requires independent rustc validation to succeed. This adequately exercises default availability and metadata resolution. I executed cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test compile_tests real_std -- --exact: one test passed, zero failed. Existing compiler warnings were emitted; they do not change that result. I added comment-only associations at the independent rustc invocation and build-time sysroot selection, then restarted and inspected fresh inputs; build.rs is additionally captured explicitly because it is not included in the implementation inventory. cargo fmt completed. No production behavior or test assertions were changed. Review judges source completeness and test adequacy; workspace-wide build and quality checks remain coordinator-owned.
